name: dprp
description: Disaster Preparedness & Response Platform for Jamaica

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,shelter,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client-shelter" "npm run dev --prefix client-admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client-shelter && npm run build --prefix client-admin
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client-shelter && npm install --prefix client-admin
